title: Do you know how to generate globally unique IDs?

blocks.en: In this post, we will explore common requirements for IDs that are used in social media such as Facebook, Twitter, and LinkedIn.

Requirements: 🔹Globally unique 🔹Roughly sorted by time 🔹Numerical values only 🔹64 bits 🔹Highly scalable, low latency 22 The implementation details of the algorithms can be found online so we will not go into detail here.
Over to you: What kind of ID generators have you used? — Check out our bestselling system design books.
